slice.name: F-present
slice.description: Read-time resolution Tool. Resolves the substrate ledger into the PresentFrame — one connected tree of stacks (every node and every edge an append-only stack of state-changes) — via one operation present(camera, temporal, standpoint) over the LMA9 read primitives. Operated through three controls (camera, lens, temporal dial); every action opens a Window. Holds the live present, the lens-dial position, the accumulating Window set, and a per-user present archive in the LIV database; projects the structure-carrying PresentView on read. Non-emitter: writes nothing to substrate.
